Asset-import configuration, not a src/*.js port, so 0 lines claimed — see docs/QUALITY_BAR.md's '#1 PRIORITY: no body is a Humanoid avatar' for the bug this fixes: every model .meta in the project imported as Generic (animationType: 2), so `CharacterRig.IsHumanoid` (`Anim.avatar.isHuman`) was false for every body, gating off torso twist, FootPoses, ShoulderPocket, seat/boarding poses and arm bones everywhere they are read. `.claude/skills/unity/SKILL.md:285` already states the intent ('the 3 humanoid bodies go through FBX ... so Unity's Avatar auto-mapper works') — it was simply never applied.

HumanizeCharacterRigs.cs sets `ModelImporter.animationType = Human` + `avatarSetup = CreateFromThisModel` and reimports banana.fbx/eggplant.fbx/toad.fbx (Assets/Art/Characters/). It does NOT touch elephant.fbx — the elephant is deliberately Generic/Procedural (characters.js:514, CharacterRoster.IsProceduralBody) and CharacterRoster.IsHumanoidBody(id) already encodes exactly this split; this script only names banana/eggplant/toad.

Bone names found by inspection before any mapping was attempted (identical 22-bone UE-Mannequin-style skeleton on all three bodies, printed by the script's own BONES log line): pelvis, spine_01, spine_02, spine_03, clavicle_l, upperarm_l, lowerarm_l, hand_l, clavicle_r, upperarm_r, lowerarm_r, hand_r, neck_01, Head, thigh_l, calf_l, foot_l, ball_l, thigh_r, calf_r, foot_r, ball_r (plus Armature/Body/Icosphere non-bone nodes). No finger bones exist in this rig.

Unity's OWN auto-mapper (step 2 in the task's approach, tried BEFORE any manual mapping) actually succeeded for all three bodies on the real shipped FBX: banana 22/22 human bones mapped, eggplant 22/22, toad 19/22 (missing UpperChest + LeftToes + RightToes only) — `avatar.isHuman=true` and `avatar.isValid=true` for all three. The manual-mapping fallback (HumanDescription.human/.skeleton built from the inspected bone list above, mapped by hand: pelvis->Hips, spine_01->Spine, spine_02->Chest, spine_03->UpperChest, neck_01->Neck, Head->Head, clavicle_l/r->Left/RightShoulder, upperarm_l/r->Left/RightUpperArm, lowerarm_l/r->Left/RightLowerArm, hand_l/r->Left/RightHand, thigh_l/r->Left/RightUpperLeg, calf_l/r->Left/RightLowerLeg, foot_l/r->Left/RightFoot, ball_l/r->Left/RightToes) is written and reachable (HumanizeCharacterRigs.ManualMap) but was never exercised in practice, because the auto-mapper already cleared the bar every ported accessor actually needs: all 16 HumanBodyBones the Character/*.cs files read (Hips, Spine, Neck, Head, Left/RightUpperLeg, Left/RightLowerLeg, Left/RightFoot, Left/RightUpperArm, Left/RightLowerArm, Left/RightHand) are present on all three bodies, including toad; toad's missing LeftToes/RightToes already fall back to Foot via the existing `?? HumanBodyBones.LeftFoot`-style code in CharacterRig.cs/FootPoses.cs, and UpperChest is never read by any ported file.

AvatarGateProbe.cs is the gate-is-open proof the task explicitly asked for (the '~50 probes exercise the maths, none assert the gate' lesson): it loads the real shipped FBX for all 4 roster bodies, builds a real CharacterRig, and prints IsHumanoid/AvatarValid/Hips/RightHand/LeftUpperArm-bone-present/FootPoses.Build(rig).Valid (via reflection, since FootPoses.cs is this port's own DO-NOT-EDIT file and Build/PoseRig are private)/ShoulderPocket.Measure(rig,L/R).Valid/Procedural, with booleans printed lower-case per this project's own documented bool.ToString() trap.
